purpose: Publish and verify the canonical dedicated outbox worker image through the existing main image publisher, as a separately reviewed IR-20 release prerequisite after the core change.
requiredInvariants: The existing publisher retains its authority and existing image jobs.
Require actual registry digest, full source revision and canonical non-root worker process identity.
Do not expose environment values or raw image inspection output.
Image publication does not establish server deployment or production acceptance.
Fresh independent review and applicable CI precede a manual SHA-bound merge.
